Generates electricity for stationary machines.

Stores and equalizes network heat while exchanging with its surroundings.
Burns ordinary furnace fuel into network heat; it does not generate rotation.
Transfers heat by converting hot and cold fluids. Hold the Ponder key to see the setup.
Unbinds adjacent Impossible Matter into AE power and heat; requires FE containment and a working heat sink.
Skips the night; does not change your permanent spawn.
Melts nearby snow; its warmth reaches only a local area.
Body temperature and world temperature are separate readings.

Nether only; each Soul Sprout supplies four fuel units.
Purity 3 is safe: no poison or nausea chance.
Passive vertical transfer from canvas and iron fittings; no rotational power or redstone required.
Collects four rain portions under open sky.
Drink directly or bottle it; bottled rain uses Thirst's configured default purity.
With Sodium Dynamic Lights, a worn helmet emits level 15; no fuel or toggle.
Armor slot protects; Curios head slot provides light only.
Reads the current season; crop suitability and weather still change over the seasonal cycle.
Outputs a 0–15 redstone signal that tracks progress through the current season.
Outputs redstone while a forming tornado is within the configured siren distance.
Sounds nearby forming tornadoes and intense sand or snow storms; range is configurable.
Right-click to inspect local deadly-storm odds; this is probability, not a live storm warning.
Measures local airborne pollution; contamination still moves and must be filtered or cleaned.
Protects the wearer from breathing pollution; it does not remove contamination from the world.
Plant in suitable soil and biome to grow the matching species.
Final death grants fragments based on XP held then.
Each installed fragment supplies 1 LP/t to an adjacent Blood Altar.
Place beside a Blood Altar; use Heart Fragments to increase LP production.
Craft from ordinary materials; a Heart Block beside it supplies LP.
Craft from iron and a cauldron. Four Font trophies are for impure chalk.
Used for Dragonsteel Tinkers' Construct tools with equal stats across variants. Replaces native Dragonsteel gear.
Transmission parts consume SU; larger, faster networks cost more capacity.
Powered-train fuel cost rises sharply with speed; stopped trains do not drain fuel.
Automatic crafting begins after Create's Mechanical Crafter.
Courier Lattice unlocks the pipe network; four lattices make the first 32 pipes.
Blank modules require an Oratchalcum Mechanism from Ratlantis.
High-tier modules require an Arcane Logistics Core from Ratlantis.
Use to tame wild rats. Ordinary cheese cannot tame them.
Used to build bulk rat transport, the first Pretty Pipes network, and portable storage.
Used to build ordinary pipe modules and Create request-network integration.
Used to build high-tier pipe modules and advanced logistics automation.
High-throughput transfer requires a Courier Lattice from Ratlantis.
Encode a Blank Pattern for a crafting or processing recipe. Crafting uses a powered network; processing sends inputs to an external machine.
Autocrafting needs patterns, ingredients, and powered crafting machinery; storage alone is not automation.
Launch requires a valid destination, thrust, and delta-v; controls alone do not make a rocket flight-ready.
Use to pilot a ship. Ship travel is optional.
Use for moving parts on Clockwork vehicles.
Adds propeller propulsion to Clockwork vehicles.
Use compressed air for Clockwork flight.
Adds active stabilization to advanced Clockwork vehicles.
Adds gas-thruster propulsion to Clockwork vehicles.
Wheel for basic Trackwork vehicles. Vehicle building is optional.
Adds active track-level control to Trackwork vehicles.
Surveys, drives, and builds rails and shallow bridges.
Uses engine power first, then fuel from its working inventory.
Stores fuel or energy on the engine item.
Switches to the built-in coal firebox when depleted.
Crafting Tier II consumes the matching Tier I module.
Place beside a reachable rail endpoint to add a Beetle route; it does not control other trains.
Use empty-handed for Font travel; the seal ends the current round trip early.

Plant seeds or planting material, not produce.
Mature crops return off-origin seeds, sometimes two. Persistent-harvest types do not.
Sends stored topic messages within one dimension.
A nearby sender relay pays 4 energy plus 1 per started 32 payload bytes.

Assigns a villager profession. Traders at this workstation accept only the matching spirit color.
Stores Malum spirits and, with Economy installed, Better Content trade currencies.
Reports local, regional, and server-wide foot-traffic without consuming or clearing traces.

Permanently resets the active world through a staged process.
Dry raw food on Hexerei's rack; it spoils 90% slower and cannot be cooked.
Build pressure processing from the PneumaticCraft air path; pressure machines retain their native operating rules.
Manufacture TaCZ guns, ammunition, and attachments at staged workbenches.
Build with an AE Logic Package and place on a chest. Drop a TaCZ gun nearby, then add ammo nearby or in the chest.
Wood barrels use a plank ring; wood chests use a vanilla chest. Storage capacity stays native.
Prepare raw Soulstone from Black Shale in a heated Hexerei cauldron; smelt it into processed Soulstone.
Native Malum quartz joins the Forge quartz gem tag for compatible industrial recipes.
Use Blighted Gunk in a tier-zero Blood Altar to make plantable Growth (2,000 LP).
Cthonic Gold comes from the native ritual using ordinary gold blocks and Malum's exact catalysts.
Heat crushed Soulstone with Malum Hex Ash in Create mixing; native smelting continues the route.
Native Runewood supports the Spirit Altar; its world generation and lore remain Malum-owned.
One hook; 16-block range, line speed 12, and pull speed 4. Softer vertical pull guides surface contact. Uses normal fire and retract controls.
Up to two hooks; 16-block range, line speed 8, and pull speed 3. Uses ReHooked’s normal fire and retract controls.
Up to two hooks; 16-block range, line speed 10, and pull speed 4. Catches solid edges within 0.2 blocks. Fire/retract normally.
One hook; 12-block range, line speed 8, and pull speed 3. Full pull on leaves; 65% elsewhere. Uses normal fire and retract controls.
One hook; 16-block range, line speed 8, and pull speed 3. Pulls for three ticks, then holds for two, repeating every five ticks.
One hook; 12-block range, line speed 10, and pull speed 4. Hooks boats; pull within 2.5 blocks to board. Mob grappling stays shared.
Can fire two hooks; retract to recall a deployed hook.
Can fire four hooks; retract to recall a deployed hook.
Blaze hooks can set nearby entities on fire; retract to recall a deployed hook.
The Ender Hook has a 96-block range in default settings; retract to recall it.
Can fire three hooks; retract to recall a deployed hook.
Creative flight is disabled by default.
